capabilities: Chat with AI providers in a sidebar panel with persistent history
Answer questions from vault notes via RAG search with clickable sources
Translate, shorten, improve, or explain selected text from the right-click menu
Replace selected note text with the AI response
Add the current note to the chat context
disambiguation: Despite the ya-gpt id suggesting a Yandex-only tool, it supports five providers, not just YandexGPT.
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README recommends installing via BRAT for beta testing. Groq is free; the other providers are paid. Security section claims keys and chat history stay local and no analytics are collected.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, so users cannot chat with an LLM, query their notes, or rewrite selected text inside the app.

relations.evidence: multi-provider AI support: Yandex AI Studio, Groq (free), OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, GigaChat (Sber)
relations.plugin: Groq, OpenAI, Anthropic, Yandex AI Studio, GigaChat

requires.name: API key for at least one provider (Groq, Yandex AI Studio, OpenAI, Anthropic, or GigaChat)

summary: Multi-provider AI chat plugin (Yandex AI Studio, Groq, OpenAI, Anthropic, GigaChat) with sidebar chat, RAG vault search, and inline text editing.
